title: The Émile Boutmy scholarship
field: Social sciences, humanities and public affairs
about: Sciences Po's Émile Boutmy scholarship is for first-time, non-EU applicants admitted to an undergraduate or master's programme. Undergraduate applicants from foreign secondary schools must apply for the September 2027 intake by 13 January 2027; scholarship decisions follow by the end of April.
requirements: First-time applicants to Sciences Po from a non-European Union state whose household does not file taxes within the EU
Must be admitted to an undergraduate or master's programme
Scholarship must be selected in the online application; no scholarship applications after submission of the Sciences Po application

upskill.name: the Academy catalog
why: The stated requirements ("First-time applicants to Sciences Po from a non-European Union state...", "Must be admitted to an undergraduate or master's programme") are eligibility rules no course objective covers; shortlist scores came from generic words ("no", "application", "social"), so the post links to the Academy catalog, not a specific course.
